newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Utd Tractors says has 7.0 trln rph deals.
newsitem.headline: Utd Tractors says has 7.0 trln rph deals.

text.p: Indonesian heavy equipment distributor and mining contractor PT United Tractors said on Tuesday it had secured mining contracts worth more than seven trillion rupiah.
"We are currently working on gold, coal and other mining projects with total contract value of more than seven trillion rupiah," director Frans Santoso told Reuters.
Santoso said the contracts included construction in gold and coal mining projects in several parts of Indonesia but declined to give further details.
